tasks.goal: Patrol the Goal Wall perimeter on the campus ring road so agents can read the posted goal, pausing at each display kiosk.
tasks.terrain: Paved campus roads and paths (741 road features) ringing the lagoon; watch for curb cuts, tree wells (177 trees) and lagoon-edge drop-offs near water.
success: Visits all kiosk waypoints within 15 min
Mean position error < 0.3 m at each stop
safety_stops: E-stop on slope > 15 deg (max relief 5.3 m, gentle)
Stop if water within 1 m of path edge
Stop on unmapped pedestrian within 2 m
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the patrol route file and the posted goal text before each run.

tasks.goal: Map the Coordination Floor atrium where Slack/Linear status screens live, building an occupancy grid for agent-navigation services.
tasks.terrain: Polished atrium floors between the four large campus buildings; glass walls, planters, pillars and furniture clusters are primary obstacles.
success: Beacon detections for all status screens logged
safety_stops: Tip detection from IMU stops gait
tasks.human_in_loop: A person reviews and signs off the final map before it is served to other agents.

tasks.goal: Stand at the Assignment Board and read ticket cards aloud, converting assignments into speech and JSON for the Assigner agent.
tasks.terrain: Flat indoor floor in front of the board; ensure stable stance on smooth tile with no trip hazards within 1 m.
safety_stops: Stop if a human reaches for the board
tasks.human_in_loop: A person verifies assignment text before it is dispatched to executors.

tasks.goal: Carry printed decision drafts from the Decision Room to human stewards around the lagoon loop for final vote - never enacting anything itself.
tasks.terrain: Outdoor campus paths with mild grade (5.3 m relief), pedestrian traffic, benches and tree root heave along the lagoon ring; wet pavement near slough edges.
success: Delivers to all steward stations within 20 min
Payload secured flag true 100% of transit
Each delivery yields a scanned receipt
safety_stops: Stop on detected human within 2 m
E-stop on stair or dock edge near lagoon
tasks.human_in_loop: Only stewards cast the final vote; Spot carries paper and never signs, enacts or transfers anything.

tasks.goal: Pick task kits from inbound totes and place them on the assignment staging shelf for executor agents, tracking every pick in JSONL.
tasks.terrain: Fixed workbench in an indoor bay; clutter limited to totes, bins and shelf slots; no floor hazards for the fixed base.
success: Place error < 2 cm in shelf slot
JSONL record per pick within 100 ms
safety_stops: Human hand within workspace envelope stops motion
Abnormal force on grasp releases object
tasks.human_in_loop: A person approves the kit manifest; reserved actions like proposal.enact stay outside the bay entirely.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude swarm survey along the lagoon perimeter to verify execution-bay delivery routes are clear, streaming positions back to the Coordinator Agent.
tasks.terrain: Open air over the lagoon ring; hazards are building corners on the four-building campus, tree canopies (177 trees) and wind funneling between structures near Belmont Slough.
success: Route clearance verdict published per segment
safety_stops: Human detected within 3 m of landing pad holds descent
tasks.human_in_loop: A person authorizes each flight window and reviews the clearance verdicts before routes are committed.

tasks.goal: Deliver voting tablets from the Decision Room supply cart to the steward table and back away, supporting the human-only final vote.
tasks.terrain: Indoor carpet-to-tile transitions, table legs and chair cluster around the steward table; doorway widths ~0.9 m between rooms.
success: Places tablet within 5 cm of table target
Backs away 1.5 m after handover cue
safety_stops: Stop on human within 1 m of arm
Torque limit on grasp aborts pick
tasks.human_in_loop: Stewards take the tablets and cast final votes themselves; the robot only fetches and places.
